summary: Diff implements substantial frontend work for Prescriber Details (state load/save flow, validation) and adds warm-neutral theming plus drug-details fallback handling. However, evidence is insufficient/absent for several explicit requirements: backend-side prescriber validation/storage behavior, curated drug dataset completeness/up-to-date updates, and some exact UI label/dropdown requirements. Diff also appears to introduce unrequested features (e.g., Drug-Drug Interaction tab/WAVEBOT) and a blue-themed footer that conflicts with the warm-neutral palette constraint.

missing_requirements.requirement: Prefix dropdown options must display exactly "Dr.", "Practitioner Nurse", and "Pharmacist"; Prescriber Details UI must show fields with the requested English labels (including "Mail ID"), and saved values must display consistently for the selected patient.
missing_requirements.reason: PrescriberDetailsSection shows state + validation and loads existingDetails, but the diff excerpt is truncated before the actual SelectItem option labels and the rendered field labels; cannot confirm the prefix dropdown visible labels are exactly as required or that the email field label uses "Mail ID" (not only in validation text).
evidence: frontend/src/components/CaseSummary.tsx (shows prefix label mapping, but not the Prescriber Details editor dropdown labels)

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must reject prescriber details submissions with empty strings for required fields and return a clear English error; backend storage/API must support required fields per patientId without type mismatches.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and shows no prescriber-details types, storage map, save/get methods, or validation logic; migration.mo exists but is a no-op and does not evidence a schema or validation update.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit/update the built-in Drug Database datasets so shipped records have complete core fields, banned drugs show a clearly labeled "Ban Reason & Safety Information" section, consistent fallbacks, and dedupe/normalization keeps banned entries winning.
missing_requirements.reason: DrugDetailsModal adds field fallbacks like "Not available", but the diff summary provides no evidence of curated dataset updates, normalization/deduplication rules, or a specifically labeled "Ban Reason & Safety Information" section guaranteed for banned drugs.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (mentions multiSourceDrugService usage but no dataset content changes shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: End-to-end patient case flow review ensuring no broken/placeholder behavior in Prescriber Details and Drug Database modules; Case Summary must display saved prescriber details without glitches; user-facing text consistent English (e.g., "Mail ID").
missing_requirements.reason: Some CaseSummary and PrescriberDetails work is shown, but the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that Drug Database list states (loading/empty/error) were audited/fixed, nor that placeholder behaviors were removed beyond the existing export placeholder toast.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (high-level claims; lacks concrete diff evidence for all required UI states)

hallucinated_features.description: Added/claimed a new "Drug-Drug Interaction Database" tab and WAVEBOT widget integration on the Dashboard.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; BuildRequest non-goals explicitly exclude real-time collaboration/chat features, and interaction DB expansion is not part of the prescriber/drug dataset/theme scope.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt ("pages/Dashboard.tsx": "nine primary tabs including new Drug-Drug Interaction Database tab"; "WAVEBOT widget integration")

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a professional white/blue pharmaceutical theme in the Footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 explicitly asks for a warm neutral palette and to avoid blue/purple as the primary theme colors; a blue-themed footer is unrequested and conflicts with this constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Added backend/migration.mo even though no stable-state schema change is evidenced.
hallucinated_features.reason: Constraint: only generate backend/migration.mo if a stable-state schema change is required for existing persisted data; migration.mo shown is a no-op returning the old state unchanged and the diff does not evidence a required schema migration.
evidence: backend/migration.mo (run(old) returns old; "unchanged if not updated")
